hero.headline: A venture in destination thinking.
hero.subheadline: Tourin represents Ārohana's conviction that travel should be built around depth, landscape, culture and respectful human presence.

journeys.title: Nubra Valley & Silk Route Passage
journeys.overview: Cross the highest motorable passes into the dune landscapes of Nubra, staying at boutique valley retreats and monastery guest houses.

journeys.title: Changthang Nomadic High Lakes
journeys.overview: Pangong Tso to Tso Moriri. Camp with Changpa pastoralists and witness untouched high-altitude wetlands.

journeys.title: Zanskar Gorge & Ancient Monasteries
journeys.overview: Traverse the newly opened roads into the heart of Zanskar, exploring millennium-old cave monasteries and living Buddhist heritage.
